function.name: create_task
function.description: Delegate a task to the cloud agent. The agent keeps working after the call ends and emails the result to the caller's registered address.

intent.description: summarize_emails: anything about the caller's Gmail inbox. research: web research or any other general task.

instruction.description: The caller's request, restated clearly in one or two sentences.

pin.description: The caller's 6-digit PIN, digits only. Only include it if the caller has said it.

messages.content: One moment while I hand that over to the agent.
